rule: Open-source only, run on our own machines or free; no paid model API was called.
caveat: Accuracies come from small hand-labelled sets by one labeller (100 X posts, 100 news rows, 20 videos). Read gaps under about 10 points (20 for videos) as ties.

rows.why: Same flag rate and same follow-through as ours (1.11), but only 73% the same flags: a change with no gain.
Out of the box it flags 44% of name-days. It is built for many-feature streams, not one number a day.
Built for series with trend and seasons (sales, traffic). Daily price moves have neither; it would fit a flat line and flag on the same spread we already use. Not run.
Prophet-based detectors with heavy, old dependencies and no recent release on PyPI. Not run.
It turns a series into hundreds of features for a later model; it is not a detector. Not run.

Same models as GGUF files behind a local server; useful if several jobs must share one loaded model. Installing Ollama is a system install, which this run was not allowed to do.
